relationship_changes.basis: Faris’s inspected pages 32–33 identify Robert Barclay, born 26 November 1804, among William and Rhoda’s children. The author traces their exact names and birth dates to the couple’s family Bible, held by Mrs E. R. Harvey on 25 June 1927. Page 46 matches Robert through both wives, Phoebe McFall and Matilda Jane Campbell, and his Ohio-to-Iowa life. A descendant’s dated 1928 recollection on page 47 places brothers Robert, Joseph and Madison on adjoining Ohio farms, including their father William’s former homestead. This specific provenance and complete adult identity support 94% subjective confident inference for Robert-835’s existing father, William-563.
